name: Dewan Tuanku Syed Putra (DTSP)
notes: Primary indoor venue for USM Minggu Siswa Lestari (MSL) induction; 3,000-3,500 seat capacity.

name: Perpustakaan Hamzah Sendut 1 (PHS 1)
notes: Immediate north-adjacent landmark to DTSP; pedestrian plaza connects PHS 1 and DTSP.

name: Perpustakaan Hamzah Sendut 2 (PHS 2)
notes: Secondary library building south of DTSP near Dewan Budaya.

name: Desasiswa Restu
notes: Western ridge high-rise student accommodation complex; houses ~1,700 students.

name: Restu Bus Stop / Departure Pavilion
notes: Staging point where Restu students queue along road shoulder to board shuttle coaches. Coordinates locked from GPS telemetry start point.

name: Desasiswa Tekun
notes: RST cluster western hostel located immediately east of Restu on Tekun ridge.

name: Desasiswa Saujana
notes: Part of RST triplet between Restu and Tekun. Often shares pavilion and amenities with Restu/Tekun.

name: Desasiswa Indah Kembara
notes: Central-western campus hostel adjacent to Padang Kawad and Jalan Indah Kembara.

name: Desasiswa Aman Damai
notes: South-western hostel cluster south of Padang Kawad.

name: Desasiswa Bakti Permai
notes: Northern-central hostel adjacent to Pusat Sejahtera and science schools.

name: Desasiswa Cahaya Gemilang
notes: North-eastern perimeter hostel near Pusat Sukan Minden and Bukit Gambir gate.

name: Desasiswa Fajar Harapan
notes: Central-southern hostel near Eureka complex and chemical science faculty.

name: DTSP Drop-Off Curb & Holding Reservoir
notes: Kerbside drop-off zone and open roadway staging reservoir where 300-400 students wait under open sun.

name: Padang Kawad USM (Central Parade Ground / Transit Hub)
notes: Central transit junction and bus hub connecting western residential ridge to central academic core.

name: Jejantas Padang Kawad / Indah Kembara Pedestrian Footbridge
notes: Pedestrian bridge connecting the Tekun/Restu ridge down toward Padang Kawad.
